limitations.note: The rewrite kept a two-input cadence instead of fixing the counter to cycle through three accepted bytes and making the second packing branch fire on the third byte.
The test passed because it expected no output on the third accepted byte, when it should have expected valid_out high with data_out equal to 12'h456.
